```python
import re

def text_match_one(text):
    return bool(re.search(r'ab+', text))
```

This matches an `a` followed by one or more `b`s anywhere in the string. `text_match_one("ac")` returns `False`, as the assertion requires. The lazy `ab+?` gives the same result for a yes/no check, so either works. I didn't use the anchored `^ab+$` because it only accepts strings that are exactly `a` plus `b`s, which would reject `"abba"` and other strings that contain the pattern.
